subject: SIN function
notes: 15.82.4 r1 is a conjunction and both halves are pinned: the APPROXIMATION at the sine's exact points (0, the quarter-turn +1/-1, the sixth-turn +1/2, rounded at 6 fraction digits so no implementor precision is borrowed) and the CODOMAIN measured over a 2001-point sweep from -10.00 to +10.00 (OOB=000000) plus PEAK=IN exactly at the bound. No clamp is owed because 15.82.4's bounds are CLOSED, unlike 15.75.4 RANDOM's OPEN 'less than one' -- so IntrinsicCatalog's Codomain None for SIN is correct, and QUARTER=+1000000 is the drift guard that would drop to +0999999 if a UnitOpen clamp were ever applied by analogy. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Intrinsics/CobolIntrinsics.TwoPi.cs#ReduceTwoPi (ReduceTwoPi (mod-2pi reduction from 2pi up) was replaced by ReduceQuarterTurns, the quadrant-and-residue reduction that also covers arguments near every multiple of pi/2 (kb/Work PB1041); the new site is on the row)
